moments.author: Nikita Kucherov
moments.quote: Reports say I won’t re-sign and have requested a trade
moments.why: It’s jaw‑dropping: the NHL’s reigning MVP wants out of Tampa Bay, sparking massive trade buzz and fan uproar.

moments.author: Jalen Brunson
moments.quote: Jalen Brunson has been named the Professional Athlete of the Year by the Philadelphia Sports Writers Association
moments.why: Knicks fans, Philly rivals included, are celebrating this hometown‑rooted superstar being crowned athlete of the year.

moments.author: JJ Redick
moments.quote: patience is key—and got hemorrhoid cream courtside, wild night
moments.why: That odd courtside moment plus his patience take in broadcast blew up, becoming a viral meme.

moments.author: Stephen Curry
moments.quote: pulled off a crazy move on Luka—epic
moments.why: A flashy Curry highlight vs. Luka sparked huge reaction among NBA fans, fueling trending #Steph and #Luka topics.
